name: job-search
description: Run a whole job hunt from Claude Code or from inside Second Brain Studio: sweep the market against your own criteria, tailor a CV per role, fill the application, and keep the results as an indexed layer of your Second Brain.

network.why: Job discovery reads public job listings: open job-board APIs, the employers' own careers boards, and — only if the user turns it on in their search criteria — LinkedIn's public, no-login job search. It never logs in to a job board. The Second Brain Link engine itself stays zero-network; this plugin is a separate distribution surface and declares its access here.
endpoints: www.linkedin.com (public job search only, when enabled in the user's criteria)
employer career pages and job boards reached by WebFetch
